citations.claim: At step 591 approach S (index 2) shows red with queue 96 and red wait 201, exceeding limit 200
At step 590 approach S already at red wait 200 with queue 96 while EW holds green
At step 500 S wait already 110 with queue 76 during extended EW green under W detector_fail

counterfactual.change: Removed the single detector_fail event on W; with detectors visible the actuated controller cycles normally and S gets green, so no max_wait violation in same 591 steps.

explanation: With actuated control, a detector_fail on W makes the controller unable to see W queue. E has continuous arrivals keeping EW demand visible, so EW green is never gap-terminated and the recall of long-waiting NS/S does not preempt it; EW holds green from ~step 392 through 590, starving S to wait 201s. Removing the detector_fail restores normal cycling and removes the failure.

violation.detail: approach 2 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: The north-south approaches sit at red while east-west holds green through steps 588-590 as a long queue of blue squares builds on the waiting approach. At step 591 the east-west signals finally turn yellow, showing the held green ending only after the prolonged starvation.
